bookmark.status: Heartwarming stories library to inspire community participation
priority: SEO strategy if stories go public

IO3_transformations.operation: Nominated resolved request becomes published story after all-party consent. Neighborhood-level location only.

DW2_downstream_pipeline.description: Story appears in resolved tab and trending

P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: Consent collection from multiple parties can delay publication.
P.P2_defensibility: All-party consent prevents privacy violations. Takedown at any time builds trust.
P4_failure_modes: Story contains identifying info beyond names
P.P5_backup_plan: Stories without full consent stay in draft. 30-day consent timeout then draft deleted.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Simulate failure scenario in staging with mock data
P.P7_testing_strategy: Test consent flow with 2+ participants. Test takedown immediate removal. Test photo moderation.

L.L1_legal_considerations: All-party consent required. Takedown at any time by any participant. Soft delete (retained for safety).
L.L3_consent_requirements: All named participants must consent before publication.
L.L4_liability_notes: Published stories use first name + last initial only. Neighborhood location only.

F.F2_accounting_considerations: Allocated to help module operational budget

S.S1_cybersecurity: Stories public within app. Future: potentially web-accessible (SEO considerations).
S.S2_data_privacy: Neighborhood-level location. No exact addresses. First name + last initial only.
S.S4_access_control: Any participant can create. All must consent. Any can takedown.
S.S5_audit_requirements: Consent log. Takedown log. Publication log.

X.X2_open_questions: Decide if stories library will be web-accessible
